Case study
One lead, start to finish.
Clara from Northwind asks Acme for a demo. Here's everything Cal.com does between her pressing Continue and the meeting landing on the right calendar.
Routing form
A lead says who they are
Clara answers four questions on Acme's site: her work email, company size, region and what she needs. That's all a route needs to go on.
Routes
Her answers meet your rules
Cal.com checks the routes in order. Over 500 people in EMEA matches Enterprise EMEA, so she goes to the enterprise link.
Round robin
The right rep is next in line
Only reps tagged EMEA and Enterprise are in the running. Lena has the fewest meetings this week, so this one is hers.
Booking page
She sees Lena's times, nobody else's
The booking page opens on Lena's free slots. Clara picks Monday at 10:30 and confirms, without ever choosing a rep.
Salesforce
The CRM is right before the call
The meeting goes on Lena's calendar, and Salesforce logs it on Clara's lead with Lena as the owner. Nobody updates a record by hand.

Describe a lead and Cal.ai runs it through the form, then tells you which route it matches and where it goes.

Questions about Routing
How forms route, what they connect to, and what it costs.
Ask a question
What are Routing Forms?
A short form people fill in before they book. Their answers decide where they go next: a booking link, a team member, an external page or a message of your own.
Do I need to write code?
No. You build the questions and the routes in Cal.com, then share the form's link or embed it on your site.
How do I set one up?
Open Routing in Cal.com, create a form, add your questions, then add routes that say where each set of answers goes. Test it with the preview before you share it.
Does it work with Typeform or my own form?
Yes. Routing works with external forms such as Typeform, so you can keep the form you have and let Cal.com do the routing.
Can it route by region, language or deal size?
Yes. Give your team members attributes like region, segment or language, and a route can send a lead only to the people whose attributes match.
Can it send customers to their account owner?
Yes. With Salesforce connected, a route can look up the lead's account and book the owner, with a fallback when the owner isn't free.
Which plan includes Routing?
Routing is part of Organizations, at $37 per user per month. It covers what teams buy Chili Piper's Concierge, Distro and Handoff for.
